description.narrative: Målet med projektet är att bidra till utvecklingen av bättre och mer inkluderande styrelseformer i Serbien där beslut om miljöfrågor bygger på enighet. Utbildningens mål är: 1) Funktionell dialog mellan miljö CSO och statlig sektor. 2) Miljö CSO proaktivt påverka beslutsfattande på alla nivåer.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The intervention maintaines its effects at reasonable level, it remains relevant and with strong potential to deliver the objectives. The project implementation in the first 18 months (31 October 2012 to 30 April 2014) has been ongoing smoothly and the expected outputs been delivered timely and in line with the budgets. Component-wise, available data indicate that the grants’ components in the two programmes are likely to have produced sustainable outcomes both in terms of external effects and through enhanced CSO cooperation. It appears likely that the Networking part of the Component has served increased CSO cooperation, while the consultation process under Component 3 is still expected to enhance the dialogue between two sectors. The available information at this stage indicate that the consultation processes have represented a useful learning process for some ECSOs and was a good and innovative attempt.
